answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 182970 Country: Sri+Lanka Title: Meanings of names Rimaz and Rukaiya Question: What is the meaning of name RIMAZ and from which origin this name has come and also can I know the meaning for the name Rukaiya? Answer ID: 182970 Posted on: Oct 13, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 217/150/N=3/1443) I do not know the meaning of Rimaz and from where it is derived. And Ruqaiya is a good name, this is the name of one of the daughters of our beloved and Holy Prophet (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) and this virtue is enough for this name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
